name: Monitor Process Quality Control
implementation_notes: process_quality_control_record/process_quality_control_detail local SQLite tables added to localSchema.ts (CREATE_PROCESS_QUALITY_CONTROL_RECORD/CREATE_PROCESS_QUALITY_CONTROL_DETAIL, appended to CREATE_TABLE_STATEMENTS) -- mirrors clarification_record/clarification_detail's shape, following the hourly-grid (dynamic add-row/remove-row) pattern. This station has the MOST non-time_slot columns of any station in the project (16: Shift, 12 numeric readings, QC Inspector ID, QC Engineering Corrective Actions, Findings), still no enum/status columns at all
processQualityControlRecordRepo.ts covers all 3 mobile Process Quality Control screens (070/080/090) in one file, same convention as clarificationRecordRepo.ts covering screens 069/079/089

createDraft() inserts ONLY the header row -- process_quality_control_detail rows are added one at a time by the user in Form Process Quality Control via 'Tambah baris', exactly mirroring clarificationRecordRepo.ts's pattern

'Jumlah Baris Time-Slot Tercatat' counter is a plain COUNT(*) of process_quality_control_detail rows belonging to today's records -- no filled-row filter, mirrors Clarification's Monitor counter exactly

Router: route name 'monitor-process-quality-control' registered in router/index.ts -- StationListView.vue (screen-006) already had this route name pre-wired in MONITOR_ROUTE_NAMES and a 'process-quality-control': false placeholder in draftStatusByType; this implementation wires the real processQualityControlRecordRepo.getDrafts() call into StationListView.vue's Promise.all, replacing that placeholder with processQualityControl.length > 0, same additive pattern Clarification used for this same pre-existing scaffolding -- this is the FINAL of the 10 MVP stations from the 2026-08-31 batch to be wired up

Added getProcessQualityControlDraftsMock hoisted mock, vi.mock() registration, and getProcessQualityControlDraftsMock.mockResolvedValue([]) call in every beforeEach block in mobile/tests/StationListView.spec.ts (mirroring the existing getClarificationDraftsMock pattern exactly), per explicit task instruction -- all 27 tests in that shared file pass

REVISI 2026-10-03: spec Playwright mobile/tests/e2e/monitor-process-quality-control.spec.ts ditulis (8 test) dan lulus dalam run penuh suite Playwright mobile (727 lulus / 0 gagal, 65 spec) — known issue 'spec e2e belum ada' ditutup.

Round 3 2026-10-05 (d5da9cf): MonitorProcessQualityControlView.vue — useBusyAction membungkus onNewData() (createDraft + await router.push), tombol New Data :disabled/:aria-busy + BusyLabel 'Membuat…', CSS .action-button:disabled dan [aria-busy='true'];

status memuat diganti LoadingState variant list (draft-list-loading). Bug diperbaiki: ketukan ganda New Data membuat 2 draft. Uji: loadingStates.screens.spec.ts (bersama, 18 Monitor: LoadingState + ketukan ganda tepat satu draft); e2e/loading-states.spec.ts memakai Monitor Boiler Room sebagai sampel.

deferred_items.description: syncService.ts's syncAllRecords() was NOT extended with a syncProcessQualityControlRecords() function (unlike Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping/Kernel Plant/Process Water/Effluent Plant/Storage Tank/Engine Room/Boiler Room/Clarification, which each have one calling POST /api/process-quality-control-records via the mobile 'Sinkronisasi' button)
deferred_items.reason: Out of this 6-screen task's explicit scope; the most recent precedent station (Clarification) made the same deferral decision for the same reason. The web POST/PATCH routes are already dual-guarded ('auth:web,sanctum' + operator role) so wiring this up later requires no backend route change, only a syncService.ts addition.
